bodyHtml:
TP-100 Thermal Expansion Tank

100-Liter (28 Gallon) Extra-High Capacity Tank for Hot Water Systems & Commercial Water Heaters | Aquasky THERMAL-PLUS Series | Made in Taiwan

TP-100 is engineered specifically to absorb expanded water in large-scale closed hot water systems, protecting heavy-duty water heating systems from excessive pressure and potentially hazardous conditions.

 

TP-100 has a total volume of 100 liters (28 gallons). The tank is designed to safely maintain water pressure levels with a maximum operating pressure of 10 bar (150 psi) and a maximum operating temperature of 90 °C (194 °F). 

 

It is factory pre-charged with nitrogen to 3.5 bar (50 psi) for highly stable and dependable system performance. With a diameter of 43.2 cm (17.0 inches) and a height of 76.3 cm (30.0 inches), this stand-model tank comes with a heavy-duty base, providing massive expansion absorption for demanding commercial and high-capacity residential plumbing systems.

Price InquiryContact us

Product Overview

The TP-100 is a 100-liter (28-gallon) high-capacity expansion tank engineered for large-scale domestic and commercial hot water systems. It serves as a robust safety buffer, absorbing thermal expansion to stabilize system pressure and protect your heating infrastructure from mechanical stress and relief valve discharges.

Key technical advantages include an FDA-grade polypropylene liner and a heavy-duty butyl diaphragm with 400% elongation for industrial-grade resilience. Equipped with a robust 1-inch stainless steel connection and patented LeakSafe technology, the TP-100 ensures a contaminant-free environment and superior safety for high-demand potable water applications.

Built for heavy-duty endurance, the TP-100 is protected by a Triple Grade Almond (RAL 1015) epoxy finish for maximum corrosion resistance. This unit delivers a maintenance-free, dependable performance that guarantees the longevity of your system and your absolute peace of mind, whether for residential or commercial facilities.

Key Features & Design Advantages

  • Triple Grade Almond (RAL1015) paint offers high oxidation protection and a durable finish.
  • Stainless-steel connection ensures secure, lead-free plumbing installation.
  • Heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm withstands high temperatures and frequent expansions.
  • Internal FDA-grade polypropylene liner prevents hot water from contacting the metallic shell.
  • Factory pre-charged to 50 PSI with nitrogen for reliable shock absorption and stable pressure.
  • Cold-rolled carbon steel shell provides a rugged, long-lasting build.
  • 100% made in Taiwan.

How the THERMAL-PLUS Pressure Tank Works

In closed hot water systems, thermal expansion occurs naturally as domestic water is heated. The TP-100 works in conjunction with a backflow preventer or check valve to safely absorb this expanded water. It stores the expanded water securely between the heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm and the polypropylene liner, while the nitrogen-filled air chamber compresses to accommodate the volume change. By controlling this excessive pressure, it safely maintains water pressure levels and avoids relief valve discharge.

Key benefits

  • Absorbs excess water during heating to prevent relief valve discharge.
  • Protects water heaters and plumbing from high pressure/leaks.
  • Provides a safe, stable system for residential hot water.
  • High-grade internal liner isolates water from metals, preventing tank corrosion.

Typical Applications

  • High-capacity closed-loop domestic and commercial hot water systems
  • Large-scale commercial water heating setups
  • Plumbing systems requiring a backflow preventer or check valve

Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)

Q1 : What makes the TP-100 the safest choice for maximum capacity thermal expansion management?

As domestic water is heated, it expands. In a closed system (which often includes a backflow preventer or check valve), this expansion can cause a dangerous increase in pressure.

The TP-100 safely absorbs this expanded water using a sealed compressible air cushion, controlling the excessive pressure and preventing the relief valve from discharging, ultimately making it the safest system for large facilities.

Q2 : How tall is the TP-100 when sitting on its base?

Including its stand base, the TP-100 is 30.0 inches (76.3 cm) tall.
 

Q3 : What makes the TP-100 durable and reliable for commercial use?

Aquasky's TP-100 features a heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm with an incredible 400% elongation physical property. Furthermore, it utilizes patented LeakSafe technology on the stainless connector and is coated with Triple Grade Almond (RAL1015) paint for excellent environmental resistance. It also utilizes a 50 PSIG nitrogen pre-charge, which effectively controls excessive pressure over a long service life.
